{
  "process": "Each row represents a telemarketing phone call made to a client. The sequence begins with the client's fixed profile and history (demographics, financials, prior contacts), then the call is initiated with a chosen communication method and date, the call takes place, and finally the subscription outcome becomes known after the call ends.",
  "target_known_at": "after the call ends, when the subscription decision is recorded",
  "prediction_point": "just before the call is initiated",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "prior_contact_count", "event": "before the call, from client history", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "client_age", "event": "before the call, from client profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "comm_method", "event": "at the moment the call is initiated", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "call_length_sec", "event": "during/after the call, when the call ends", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "day_of_month", "event": "at the moment the call is made (date of call)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "schooling", "event": "before the call, from client profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "charged_off", "event": "before the call, from client history", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "civil_status", "event": "before the call, from client profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "consumer_credit_flag", "event": "before the call, from client history", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "prior_campaign_result", "event": "before the call, from previous campaign outcome", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "avg_yearly_bal", "event": "before the call, from client account history", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "home_loan_flag", "event": "before the call, from client profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "occupation", "event": "before the call, from client profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "contacts_this_run", "event": "at the moment the call is made (the count of attempts so far, including this call)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "contact_mth", "event": "at the moment the call is made (month of call)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "days_since_prev_contact", "event": "before the call, from contact history", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95}
  ]
}
